video.title: AI欧腐《拿下我的橄榄球队长/Scoring on My Football Captain Stepbrother》
video.desc:
要素齐全
When Alex enters his stepbrother Liam’s world of privilege and power, the only thing they share is mutual contempt. But hate is a dangerous game—and the closer they become, the more they stand to lose. Two boys, one secret, and a line neither of them can cross. Until they do.

当 Alex 踏入继兄 Liam 那个充满特权与权势的世界，两人唯一的共同点就是互相看不顺眼。可恨意是一场危险的游戏，他们走得越近，可能失去的就越多。两个男生，一个秘密，还有一条谁都不能越过的线。直到他们越了界。
